caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object depicted is a stylized rooster, rendered in shades of dark brown and gray, with hints of green and red accentuating parts of the wings and head. The rooster stands upright on two legs which are mounted on a horizontal rod. The body is robust with pronounced feather details on the wings, body, and tail, all outlined in a slightly lighter color. The tail feathers are fanned to the left, consisting of long, layered segments, each outlined and shaded to indicate dimensionality. The head of the rooster features a small comb and a distinctive beak, both of which are shaded with green and brown hues. The drawing is composed to present the rooster in profile, facing to the right, with clear emphasis on the texture and structure of the bird’s form. No additional objects or elements appear in the drawing, and the background remains unadorned.
title: Weather Vane - Cock
